source_document: Growatt MOD/MID/MAX TL3-X & OpenAPI V1 Installation & Operation Manual, Section 7 (Troubleshooting, Fault & Warning Codes)

ERROR_102.title: Isolation Fault (ISO-F)
ERROR_102.description: Ground isolation resistance of the PV array is below the safe operational threshold.
ERROR_102.oem_definition: PV Isolation Low (Error 102 / 203 / 303). Inverter detected PV array impedance to earth ground is below the permissible safety threshold.
potential_causes: Damaged DC cable jacket or rodent chewing
Moisture in string junction box or MC4 connectors
Degraded backsheet on solar modules
Inadequate array bonding or ground fault
ERROR_102.recommended_action: Perform string insulation resistance testing per Growatt service manual. Inspect DC cable runs and replace faulty connectors.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Switch off AC breaker and DC isolators. Follow electrical lockout/tagout protocol.
Inspect DC cabling along cable trays and conduit entries for physical abrasions or water intrusion.
Disconnect individual strings and use a 1000V insulation resistance tester to pinpoint the grounded string.
Replace damaged section/connector, re-measure insulation (>1M ohm), and restore inverter power.

ERROR_106.title: Grid Overvoltage
ERROR_106.description: Grid AC voltage exceeded the upper operating threshold configured on the inverter.
ERROR_106.oem_definition: AC Voltage Out of Range (Error 106 / 300). Inverter disconnected from the grid because utility line voltage exceeds grid compliance window.
potential_causes: Grid supply overvoltage from local utility substation
High impedance on AC feeder cable during peak solar feed-in
Incorrect inverter grid standard parameter settings
ERROR_106.recommended_action: Monitor utility grid voltage. If persistent, check AC cable gauge and transformer tap settings.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure AC line-to-line and line-to-neutral voltages at the inverter AC terminals.
Verify inverter automatically reconnects when utility voltage returns within nominal limits.

ERROR_108.title: Inverter Overtemperature
ERROR_108.description: Inverter internal heatsink or ambient temperature exceeded thermal safety cutoff limits.
ERROR_108.oem_definition: Inverter Over Temperature (Error 108 / 305). Internal thermal sensors tripped thermal protection derating or shutdown.
potential_causes: Cooling fan blockage, failure, or dust accumulation
Direct solar exposure on inverter chassis without sunshade
Insufficient ventilation clearance around heatsink fins
ERROR_108.recommended_action: Inspect external cooling fans, clean heatsink fins with compressed air, and ensure ventilation clearance.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Allow inverter heatsink to cool down before servicing.
Inspect external fans for foreign debris, dust build-up, or mechanical binding.
Verify fan supply voltage and test fan rotation in maintenance mode.
Power on inverter and verify temperature stabilization below 65°C under high load.

ERROR_101.title: Grid Frequency Deviation
ERROR_101.description: Grid AC frequency deviated outside acceptable operational boundaries (47.5 Hz - 52.0 Hz).
ERROR_101.oem_definition: Grid Frequency Out of Range (Error 101 / 304). Inverter tripped due to utility frequency instability.
potential_causes: Utility grid disturbance or load-shedding transient
Diesel generator synchronization failure during islanding
ERROR_101.recommended_action: Log frequency event and monitor grid stability.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure grid frequency with calibrated power quality analyzer.

ERROR_103.title: Residual Current Trip (GFCI)
ERROR_103.description: Inverter ground fault current interrupter detected residual leakage current > 300mA.
ERROR_103.oem_definition: Residual Current Fault (Error 103 / 202 / 307). Excessive DC/AC leakage current to ground.
potential_causes: Moisture in module junction box
High parasitic capacitance to ground during morning dew
Damaged grounding connection
ERROR_103.recommended_action: Check grounding conductor and test leakage current across strings.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure DC leakage current with AC/DC clamp meter.

302.title: AC Grid Loss / No Utility (Error 302)
302.description: Utility AC grid connection is lost or main AC circuit breaker is open.
302.oem_definition: No AC Connection (Error 302 / 107). Inverter detects no AC utility voltage at output terminals.
potential_causes: Local utility grid outage or feeder trip
Tripped AC circuit breaker or open AC isolator switch
Loose AC terminal connection at inverter or distribution panel
302.recommended_action: Verify utility grid availability. If grid power is active, inspect AC circuit breaker and isolator switches. Inverter auto-reconnects when AC is restored.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Follow AC electrical safety procedures before opening distribution enclosures.
Check position of main AC breaker, RCCB/MCCB, and AC isolator switch.
Measure 3-phase line-to-line and line-to-neutral AC voltages on both sides of the AC breaker.
Restore AC breaker if tripped after verifying no short circuit, and confirm inverter grid synchronization.

300.title: AC Grid Voltage Out of Range (Error 300)
300.description: Utility AC grid voltage is outside the permissible operating window configured on the inverter.
300.oem_definition: AC V Outrange (Error 300 / 106). Grid phase voltage exceeded upper or lower statutory limits.
potential_causes: Utility grid voltage surge or brownout
High AC line impedance causing voltage rise during peak export
Incorrect country grid code setting
300.recommended_action: Inverter will auto-reconnect once grid voltage returns to normal range. If recurring at peak sun hours, inspect AC cable sizing and grid tap.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure L1, L2, L3 AC voltages at inverter terminals and main distribution board.
Confirm inverter resumes normal grid feed-in when AC voltage stabilizes.

301.title: AC Grid Phase / Terminal Fault (Error 301)
301.description: Three-phase AC grid wiring phase sequence error or missing phase detected.
301.oem_definition: AC Terminal Fault (Error 301). Incorrect phase rotation, missing phase, or neutral-live reversal.
potential_causes: Blown fuse on one of the three AC phases
Phase rotation reversed after utility or panel maintenance
Loose phase conductor in AC connector
301.recommended_action: Check all three AC phases for voltage continuity and verify phase rotation with a phase sequence meter.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Isolate AC breaker before inspecting terminal connections.
Check L1-N, L2-N, L3-N voltages and verify clockwise phase sequence.

303.title: Isolation Fault (ISO-F)
303.description: Ground isolation resistance of the PV array is below the safe operational threshold.
303.oem_definition: PV Isolation Low (Error 303 / 203). Insulation resistance between DC array and earth is below safety threshold (<100kOhm).
potential_causes: Damaged DC cable insulation or water ingress in MC4 connectors
Pinched PV wire against mounting structure
Grounded or damaged solar module
303.recommended_action: Perform string-by-string 1000V insulation resistance testing to earth. Repair grounded DC cable or connector.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Switch off AC breaker and DC isolator before disconnecting strings.
Measure insulation resistance of each PV string (+ to earth, - to earth) using a 1000V megohmmeter.

304.title: Grid Frequency Deviation
304.description: Utility grid AC frequency is outside the allowed operating range.
304.oem_definition: AC Frequency Out of Range (Error 304 / 101). Utility frequency exceeded statutory window.
potential_causes: Utility grid frequency fluctuation
Generator operation on site without proper frequency regulation
304.recommended_action: Inverter will automatically reconnect once grid frequency returns to nominal range.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Verify AC grid frequency is near 50.0 Hz.

305.title: Inverter Overtemperature
305.description: Internal inverter or IGBT heatsink temperature exceeded maximum safety threshold.
305.oem_definition: Over Temperature Protection (Error 305 / 108). Inverter internal temperature exceeded thermal protection limit.
potential_causes: Dust or debris blocking heatsink fins
Cooling fan failure
Poor cabinet ventilation or direct sunlight exposure
305.recommended_action: Clean heatsink fins, inspect cooling fans for proper operation, and ensure adequate ventilation clearance.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Inspect cooling fans and heatsink airways for dust blockage.

306.title: High DC Injection Current (Error 306)
306.description: DC current component injected into the AC grid exceeded safety limits.
306.oem_definition: Output High DCI (Error 306 / 112). Inverter AC output DC offset current exceeded statutory limit.
potential_causes: Sudden grid waveform distortion
Internal current sensor drift or IGBT asymmetry
306.recommended_action: Monitor if inverter self-recovers. If fault persists after AC/DC power cycle, contact Growatt service for current sensor check.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Perform AC and DC power cycle and monitor DCI telemetry values (rDci, sDci, tDci).

307.title: Residual Current Trip (GFCI)
307.description: Inverter ground fault circuit interrupter detected excessive residual leakage current (>300mA).
307.oem_definition: Residual I High (Error 307 / 202 / 103). Ground leakage current exceeded GFCI safety limit.
potential_causes: Moisture ingress in PV connectors or junction boxes
Damaged DC cable insulation leaking to ground
Defective module backsheet
307.recommended_action: Inspect DC array wiring and connectors for moisture or ground leakage. Measure string insulation resistance.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Test DC string leakage current and insulation resistance to ground.

308.title: PV Input Overvoltage (Error 308)
308.description: DC input voltage from PV strings exceeded the maximum allowable input voltage (1100V).
308.oem_definition: PV Voltage High (Error 308 / 113 / 408). DC string open-circuit voltage exceeds inverter hardware limit.
potential_causes: Too many PV modules connected in series in a single string
Low ambient temperature increasing string open-circuit voltage (Voc)
308.recommended_action: Immediately switch off DC isolator. Measure string Voc with a 1500V DC meter and reduce series module count if over limit.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Do not operate under load if Voc exceeds 1100V. Isolate DC switch immediately.
Measure open-circuit voltage of each string with a calibrated high-voltage DC multimeter.

200.title: DC Arc Fault Detected (AFCI)
200.description: Arc-Fault Circuit Interrupter detected dangerous electrical arcing on a PV string.
200.oem_definition: AFCI Fault (Error 200 / 124). High-frequency DC arc signature detected on PV input.
potential_causes: Loose or improperly crimped MC4 connector
Damaged DC conductor or burnt terminal in DC isolator
Faulty solar module junction box diode
200.recommended_action: Do not reset without inspection. Check all MC4 connectors, DC isolator terminals, and string wiring for signs of arcing or heat.

general_field_guidance.instruction: De-energize inverter and isolate all DC strings immediately.
Perform thermal and visual inspection of every MC4 connector and DC combiner terminal.

401.title: Cooling Fan Warning (Code 401)
401.description: One or more internal or external cooling fans are blocked or failing to rotate at target RPM.
401.oem_definition: Fan Abnormal (Warning 401 / 104). Cooling fan tachometer feedback out of range.
potential_causes: Dust, leaves, or debris obstructing fan blades
Loose fan power connector
Worn fan bearing requiring replacement
401.recommended_action: Inspect and clean cooling fan assembly. Replace fan module if bearing is seized.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check fan tray for debris and verify smooth blade rotation.

405.title: Inverter AC Overcurrent (Error 405)
405.description: Inverter AC output current exceeded hardware protection threshold.
405.oem_definition: Output Overcurrent (Error 405 / 126). Hardware or software overcurrent trip on AC output stage.
potential_causes: Short circuit or ground fault on AC output cable
Severe utility grid phase voltage dip
Internal IGBT power stage fault
405.recommended_action: Isolate AC breaker and test AC cable insulation. Restart inverter and contact OEM if fault recurs.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Verify AC phase-to-phase and phase-to-earth insulation before re-energizing.

409.title: DC Bus Overvoltage (Error 409)
409.description: Internal DC bus voltage exceeded maximum hardware threshold.
409.oem_definition: Bus Voltage High (Error 409 / 109). Internal DC link capacitor voltage exceeded safe threshold.
potential_causes: Excessive PV string open-circuit voltage
Sudden load rejection or grid disconnection under high export
Internal bus voltage sensing circuit fault
409.recommended_action: Measure PV string DC voltages and AC grid voltages. Power-cycle inverter if voltages are within spec.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check pBusVoltage, nBusVoltage, and PV string Voc.

411.title: Internal Control Board Fault (Error 411)
411.description: Internal DSP/MCU communication failure or EEPROM read/write error.
411.oem_definition: Internal Hardware Fault (Error 411 / 114 / 116). Internal processor communication or memory verification error.
potential_causes: Control board power supply disturbance
EEPROM memory corruption
Internal ribbon cable looseness
411.recommended_action: Perform full AC and DC power cycle (wait 10 minutes for bus discharge). Escalate to Growatt support if persistent.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Isolate AC and DC for 10 minutes, then restart inverter.

500.title: PV String Disconnected / Abnormal
500.description: Inverter detected zero current or abnormal voltage on an active PV string.
500.oem_definition: String Fault / Open Warning (Code 500). String current deviation or open string detected.
potential_causes: Blown DC string fuse or tripped DC MCB
Disconnected MC4 plug on array
Severe localized shading or damaged module
500.recommended_action: Measure individual string open-circuit voltages and operating currents with a DC clamp meter.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Compare MPPT and string currents (ipv1..N, currentString1..N) and inspect DC fuses.

503.title: Surge Protection Device (SPD) Fault
503.description: Internal or external DC/AC Surge Protection Device (SPD) has tripped due to a lightning or surge event.
503.oem_definition: SPD Fault (Warning 503 / 204). Surge arrestor cartridge fault indicator triggered.
potential_causes: Lightning-induced surge on DC array or AC grid
Degraded SPD varistor cartridge
503.recommended_action: Inspect SPD status windows in AC/DC distribution boxes and replace any red/tripped SPD cartridges.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check SPD visual indicator windows (Green = OK, Red = Replace).

ERR_COMM_LOST.title: Inverter / Data Logger Communication Offline
ERR_COMM_LOST.description: ShineWiFi / Shine4G / ShineLan data logger has lost connection to Growatt server or inverter RS485 bus.
ERR_COMM_LOST.oem_definition: Device Lost (lost=true / status=-1). No telemetry heartbeat received from site datalogger.
potential_causes: Site Wi-Fi router or 4G SIM internet connectivity outage
AC/DC power switched off at site
Loose Shine dongle / datalogger connection on inverter COM port
ERR_COMM_LOST.recommended_action: Verify site internet/Wi-Fi router status and check LED indicators on the Growatt Shine data logger.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Check Shine datalogger status LEDs (Blue flashing = normal server link; Red/Off = network or power loss).
Reboot site router or re-seat datalogger stick and verify live telemetry resumes.
